name: Lenovo
summary:
Lenovo is the PC maker at lenovo.com. The wordmark tile in the tab is the icon for the US shop and support pages, measured from the saved file.

Checked 12 November 2026 against lenovo.com. HTML came from https://www.lenovo.com/us/en/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://www.lenovo.com/favicon.ico.

A request to the favicon.ico URL https://www.lenovo.com/favicon.ico returned gif (32×32, 1541 bytes), not an ICO container. Formats that saved: gif.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

Largest measured bitmap: gif-32x32-01.gif at 32×32 (gif, 1541 bytes) from https://www.lenovo.com/favicon.ico.
